outcomes: The CI log of a change names the components it changed and the components that depend on them, inferred from the repository's own manifests
The same log gives the tests and the line coverage of each component, and the coverage of the lines the change added or modified
The same log lists the packages whose locked version the change added, removed, upgraded or downgraded
The evidence document carries the same facts and validates against protocol/evidence v1
nonGoals: Reading a putnami.workspace.json through go.putnami.dev/cli/model: a Putnami workspace runs its own extensions
Running a package manager, an orchestrator or the tests
Attributing a JUnit case by its class name alone, when neither its file nor its report lies in a component

requirements.text: The Nx, Node workspace, Composer and Go detectors answer for the repository. When two name one directory, the higher source wins: orchestrator, then workspace, then manifest. A changed file belongs to the innermost component that holds it. A component is changed when one of its files changed, dependent when it reaches a changed one through its edges. Edges to an unknown component are dropped. When no detector finds a component, the repository is one fallback component.

A JUnit case goes to the component that holds its test file, else to the component of the Go package its suite names, else to the component that holds its report. A covered file goes to the component that holds it. A report path is read as repository-relative, relative to the report's component or directory, absolute under the repository, or as a Go import path. Each component sums its passed, failed and skipped cases, its duration, its failing cases and its covered and instrumented lines.

The lines a change added or modified are the added lines of the diff from the merge base to the head, with no context. Each changed file that still exists and that a coverage report instruments gets its covered and instrumented changed lines and its uncovered line numbers. A line two reports instrument is covered when either covers it. Without a base or a coverage report, there is no changed-line coverage.

Each changed package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, composer.lock and go.mod is read at the merge base and at the head. A package present on one side only is added or removed; a package whose versions differ is upgraded, downgraded or, when the versions do not compare, changed. Workspace links, path packages and modules of the repository are no dependency. A lockfile that cannot be read is a diagnostic.

The text summary lists the changed and dependent components: a dependent one names the components it depends on, a changed one the other changed components it reaches, directly or not. It then lists each component's tests and coverage, the changed-line coverage with its least covered files, and the dependency changes. --output=json prints the same observation. --evidence writes the components with their impacts and edges and the same analyses, valid against protocol/evidence v1.
